name: adx_trend_funding_calm_long_hold_eth_bnb_ada_avax
rationale: Over a long hold, a strong ADX trend survives longest when perp funding is NOT overheated — hot funding presages leverage-flush reversals that kill long holds. Gate ADX above a strength floor (gt) by funding_rate below an overheating cap (lt; funding_rate is a bounded level). Long hold window (up to ~25d) lets the regime gate prove it protects the tail. Disconfirmer: a control run removes the funding cap — if long-hold ADX trends earn the same when funding runs hot, the no-overheat regime contributes no edge and this is long-horizon trend-following. Exit early if funding spikes above the cap.
catalyst: ADX above strength floor while funding_rate is below an overheating cap
